candidates.prompt_verbatim: Create one complete side-view pixel-art game animation frame of the exact red and silver Ultraman Type C from reference 1. He is being lifted belly-down on the monster's back: head right, feet left, body curled with abdomen and waist lowest, both arms attached and bent clear of the monster's head. Reference 2 shows the monster and the back contact geometry: design a pose whose head, neck and shoulders will sit safely behind and above its right-side horn crown when composited, with abdomen resting on its back, not floating. Do NOT draw the monster; draw only the complete Ultraman character, no shadows, text, border, grid, background or other objects. Reference 3 shows proportions and suit pattern but its old pose causes head and shoulder to intersect the horn, so redesign pose to avoid it. Preserve identity, anatomy, two arms, two legs, chest light, pixel art and consistent whole-character proportions. Transparent background.
